blocks.tamil_translation: whoever prayed has certainly committed shirk; whoever fasted so that others may see has certainly committed shirk; whoever gave charity so that others may see has certainly committed shirk,” Hazrat Shaddad ibn Aws (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say.

blocks.text: Explanation:- He has made those people, to whom he wanted to show his deed, partners with Allah Ta'ala. In this state these deeds are not for Allah Ta'ala but become for those to whom he wanted to show them. The one who does this becomes deserving of punishment instead of reward.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ اَوْسٍ ﵁ اَنَّهُ بَكَي، فَقِيْلَ لَهُ: مَا يُبْكِيْكَ؟ قَالَ: شَيْئًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُهُ، فَذَكَرْتُهُ، فَاَبْكَانِيْ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: اَتَخَوَّفُ عَلي اُمَّتِي الشِّرْكَ وَالشَّهْوَةَ الْخَفِيَّةَ، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! اَتُشْرِكُ اُمَّتُكَ مِنْ بَعْدِكَ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، اَمَا اِنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْبُدُوْنَ شَمْسًا، وَلَا قَمَرًا، وَلَا حَجَرًا، وَلَا وَثَنًا، وَلكِنْ يُرَاؤُوْنَ بِاَعْمَالِهِمْ، وَالشَّهْوَةُ الْخَفِيَّةُ اَنْ يُصْبِحَ اَحَدُهُمْ صَائِمًا فَتَعْرِضُ لَهُ شَهْوَةٌ مِنْ شَهَوَاتِهِ فَيَتْرُكُ صَوْمَهُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: It is said about Hazrat Shaddad ibn Aws (RA), “Once he began to weep. He was asked the reason for weeping. (He said,) “Something I heard from the Prophet ﷺ came to my mind. Those words made me weep. I heard him say, “I fear that my Ummah will be afflicted with shirk and with hidden desire.”” Hazrat Shaddad (RA) says: “O Messenger of Allah, after you
